subject: MerchantCare onboarding — credits + extension request
messages:
From: Sana Patel <sana@merchantcare.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Liu <tom.liu@merchantcare.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: MerchantCare onboarding — credits & timeline request

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team is excited about Redwood's inference performance. We've had internal delays on the data ingest side and our technical lead asked for an extra 30 days to finish the onboarding scripts. Because of the slip, Procurement asked whether Redwood can: (1) extend the trial window from 30 -> 60 days, and (2) add $10k in free credits to cover evaluation runs so we can complete the performance tests.

We realize this is outside the standard self-serve trial, but MerchantCare is basing the Q1 2027 vendor decision on this pilot. If you need a written request from Procurement, I can loop them in.

Thanks,
Sana Patel
Head of ML Platform
MerchantCare

---
Attachment: merchantcare_onboarding_notes.txt (text)
From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: MerchantCare onboarding — credits & timeline request — recommend escalation

Marissa / Grace — forwarding MerchantCare's ask. Quick context: opportunity is ~ $240k ARR first-year TCV if they convert with two additional product modules. Their current timeline slipped for reasons outside our scope; they want a 60-day trial + $10k credits.

Our standard pilot policy allows a single 30-day trial and $3k credits for pilots under $100k TCV. This request is materially above that. My recommended concession to close and protect renewal: 60-day trial + $12k credits + 10% first-year commit discount if they sign a 12-mo commit within 60 days after pilot. Expected ROI if converted: payback < 6 months.

Can you weigh in on whether to escalate to exec signoff and if so, please approve routing to Vivek for an exception (will need explicit dollar approval). I attached the latest SOW draft and MerchantCare's security questionnaire.

Thanks — Jonas
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

---
Attachments: MerchantCare_SOW_v0.3.pdf (application/pdf); merchantcare_security_questions.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:42:00 -0800
Subject: Exec approval request — MerchantCare pilot sweetener (credits + extension)

Vivek —

We have an opportunity (MC-2026-014) with MerchantCare: potential ARR ~$240k, strong chance to expand into two adjacent modules if pilot demonstrates latency/cost advantages. AE Jonas Weber requests an exception beyond standard pilot policy: 60-day trial (vs 30) + $12k credits and a 10% first-year commit discount conditioned on a 12-month commitment post-pilot.

Why I recommend approving:
- MerchantCare's tech blockers are temporary; extension materially increases chance of conversion.
- The economics still positive: modeled payback < 6 months at projected usage.
- Security screening is passing; procurement is motivated to sign once the pilot proves out.

Risks / guardrails I propose if you approve:
- Credits capped at $12k and expire at the end of the 60-day extension; no rollover.
- Pilot will include a success checklist (perf targets + cost per request) with sign-off by both parties.
- Add a short clause to the SOW that any overage usage beyond credits billed at standard rates.

Attachments: SOW v0.3, security questionnaire.

Request: your explicit approver reply (approve / modify / decline) so AE can finalize terms with customer and route DocuSign.

—Marissa Cole
Sales Director, Enterprise Accounts — Redwood Inference
From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2026 17:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Exec approval request — MerchantCare pilot sweetener (credits + extension)

Marissa / Jonas —

Approve with conditions. I support offering the 60-day extension and up to $10k in credits (not the full $12k) with the following requirements:

1) Credits capped at $10,000 and expire after the 60-day window; any consumption beyond that billed at list.
2) Add the success checklist to the SOW and require written sign-off from MerchantCare's ML lead to qualify for credits.
3) The 10% first-year commit discount is OK only if Finance pre-approves margins (finance to confirm before DocuSign).
4) AE to record updated concession in HubSpot and tag me + RevOps for audit.

If MerchantCare pushes for the $12k ask, escalate back to me with clear usage forecasts and renewal probability.

Jonas: proceed to confirm with Sana that we can do 60 days + $10k credits under these guardrails; then send them the updated SOW for signature.

—Vivek Kulkarni
VP Sales, Redwood Inference
